mentions.name: Lurk
mentions.description: Shopify app that lets merchants track competitors' prices and adjust their own in response using dynamic pricing rules. Merchants paste a URL and AI figures out the price.
mentions.problem: Making competitor price detection work reliably at scale requires handling many edge cases such as popups, ambiguous HTML, and location-based pricing.
mentions.source_excerpt: Lurk (https://apps.shopify.com/lurk): New one I just launched - allows Shopify merchants to track the prices of competitors and adjust their own in response with dynamic pricing rules.
